ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISBLANK(Quantity_Pieces__c), Quantity_Pieces__c <= 0, Free_Pieces__c < 0, ISBLANK(Unit_Price__c), Unit_Price__c < 0, Discount_Amount__c < 0, Discount_Amount__c > Gross_Amount__c, Tax_Percent__c < 0, Tax_Percent__c > 100)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter positive billed pieces, a price, and valid discounts and tax (0 to 100).
